edition.notes: Collated from Green Message, Sringeri Sharada Peetham stotra page, and Wikipedia hymn text. v2 flower-line: मन्दारपुष्पबहुपुष्पसुपूजिताय (GM) vs मन्दारमुख्यबहुपुष्प (Sringeri) — Sringeri मुख्य kept as matha recension. v5 यज्ञस्वरूपाय (primary; यक्षस्वरूपाय variant noted).

description.hi: न-म-शि-वा-य — प्रत्येक अक्षर पर एक श्लोक।
description.en: One stanza for each syllable of Na-Ma-Shi-Va-Ya.
